manifest.name: gdn-fp8-qkv-all-zo-split
manifest.description: FP8 on the recurrent state-writing projection at every depth, and on z in the shallow half; Q4_K on z and out in the deep half. Measured by section under hpc01-e4: FP8 on the deep qkv is what lowers math, multilingual and general drift (Q4_K there costs tools and general), FP8 on the shallow qkv and z keeps tools and code near V0 where shallow Q4_K costs them, and Q4_K on the deep z and out claws back memory without touching retrieval. Layer 0, attention and the MLP stay NVFP4: attention Q4_K with layer 3 native drops the 32K needles, and MLP Q4_K costs about a third of prefill. 70 FP8 units instead of #11's 94 cut the decode cost from 10% to 8%.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
